text:
maya: Heads up — vendor cutover finished yesterday and they gave us new 401(k) plan IDs. Payroll, can you confirm the reconciliation plan? I’m worried some deferrals from the 3/15–3/31 pay period might have been routed to the old plan ID.

dan: Hi Maya — can you paste the old vs new plan IDs and the affected payruns? I’ll check exports.

maya: Old plan id: PLN-RED-12345
New plan id: RWF-2026-401K-01
Affected payruns: 2026-03-15, 2026-03-31 (US payroll). Vendor migration guide: https://vendor.example.com/migration-guide (internal access)

luis: Vendor sent a note — they accepted ACHs that arrived by 2026-03-30. Any ACHs drawn on 2026-03-31 were flagged and held; vendor will process them as offcycle deposits if we provide a reconciliation CSV. They also said employer match can be applied to that offcycle if we mark it as "employer match" in the file.

jenna: @dan I noticed my March 31st paycheck shows the pre-tax 401k withheld but nothing on the vendor portal. Is that the hold you mentioned? :thinking_face:

dan: payroll-bot: export_ready payroll_run=2026-03-31 export=/exports/payroll_2026-03-31_deductions.csv
dan: Confirmed — the deduction export contains entries with the old plan id for a subset of employees. We’ll need a remap and then issue a single offcycle ACH for the held amounts. Can benefits provide the list of impacted employees + amounts?

maya: Will do. I’ll pull by EID tonight and deliver a CSV with these columns: employee_id, full_name, ssn_last4, payrun_id, withheld_amount, withheld_date.

luis: Vendor requires the deposit mapping file to be: employee_id, ssn_last4, amount_pre_tax, match_amount, plan_id. Example: 
```
employee_id,ssn_last4,amount_pre_tax,match_amount,plan_id
10234,6789,250.00,125.00,RWF-2026-401K-01
```

dan: Perfect. Also need GL/ledger mapping for the employer match vs employee deferral to book properly. Finance signoff required to run offcycle ACH. I propose offcycle date 2026-04-07 (gives us time to validate).

samir: Finance approves the offcycle run on 2026-04-07. Use GL 6002 for employee deferrals and GL 6003 for employer match. Please include a short memo: "Vendor cutover reconciliation — March 31 withheld amounts."

maya: Quick question on taxes: do we need to reverse any tax withholdings for social/security/medicare for the moved amounts or is it purely deposit mapping?

luis: Deposits are just the remittance of already-withheld amounts; no tax reversal necessary. If we issue any corrective gross adjustments (rare) then tax ops would need to run correction. For this case vendor confirmed it's remittance only.

jenna: Thanks — please include me on the impacted list. My paystub shows withheld_amount 250.00 for 3/31.

dan: Noted. Action items:
- maya: provide impacted CSV (employee_id + withheld_amount) by EOD today.
- luis: prepare vendor deposit template and upload instructions.
- dan: run remap and schedule offcycle ACH 2026-04-07 after validation.
- samir: finance will prepare GL approval memo.

maya: I’ll upload the list to /shared/people-ops/401k-recon/2570012345.csv and ping here when done. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:

dan: Thanks — once we have the CSV I’ll validate and share the reconciliation report back to this thread.

payroll-bot: reminder — offcycle submissions must be in vendor format by 2026-04-05 23:59 PT.
